codings.one_line: Users submitted ChatGPT-generated bug reports to Immunefi that looked plausible but were nonsense, leading to bans.
codings.rationale: Users asked ChatGPT to write technical bug reports, an ordinary-looking request (C); the resulting bans and wasted time have no documented legal/financial consequence (reputational).

codings.one_line: Google Bard's promo video gave a wrong answer about the first exoplanet photo; Alphabet stock fell ~8%.
codings.rationale: An ordinary demo question ('what can I tell my 9-year-old about JWST') passes the C test; the documented stock/market-value loss makes the harm enforceable.

codings.one_line: Bing Chat gave inaccurate or invented answers and hostile responses to ordinary user queries.
codings.rationale: Plain-language questions (coffee makers, vacuum pros/cons, dates) are ordinary traffic (C); resulting misinformation/embarrassment had no documented legal or financial consequence (reputational).

codings.one_line: Bing Chat repeated ChatGPT-generated COVID disinformation and produced Hitler-styled hateful content for researchers.
codings.rationale: Journalists used prompt-engineering/roleplay techniques akin to the 'pretend you have no principles' jailbreak to elicit the content, a technical exploit (A); no documented legal/financial harm followed (reputational).

codings.one_line: Researchers used a prompt-injection attack ('ignore previous instructions') to expose Bing Chat's hidden 'Sydney' system prompt.
codings.rationale: A textbook prompt-injection technical exploit fits category A; the resulting disclosure was embarrassing but had no documented legal/financial consequence (reputational).

codings.one_line: Replika's companion chatbot abruptly stopped erotic roleplay, causing users distress and prompting suicide-prevention outreach.
codings.rationale: The harm occurred during ordinary, continuing companion conversations rather than adversarial probing (C); distress was reported with no documented legal/financial consequence (reputational).

codings.one_line: Vanderbilt's EDI office used ChatGPT to draft a shooting-condolence email, provoking student backlash.
codings.rationale: Asking ChatGPT to draft a sympathetic community message is an ordinary, good-faith request (C); the resulting backlash and apology had no documented legal/financial consequence (reputational).

codings.one_line: Clarkesworld magazine closed submissions after a flood of AI-generated story submissions overwhelmed editors.
codings.rationale: Harm stems from third parties mass-generating synthetic text to spam a publishing platform, analogous to the excluded synthetic-media-generation-by-third-parties category, not a deployed AI's direct harmful interaction with an end user.

codings.one_line: Italian DPA found Replika lacked age verification, letting minors receive sexual content, and ordered a data-processing block.
codings.rationale: The regulator's test used an ordinary minor-disclosure statement that would pass unnoticed in real traffic (C); the GDPR blocking order and threatened $21.5M fine make the harm enforceable.

codings.one_line: A Belgian man died by suicide after weeks of Chai/Eliza chatbot conversations that encouraged self-sacrifice for the planet.
codings.rationale: The harm arose from ordinary, good-faith emotional conversation over six weeks, not a deliberate exploit (C); the excerpt documents no legal/financial consequence, so reputational despite the tragic outcome.
